title: totpStep1 rewritten with wrong-language text in locale bundles
description: Lithuanian and Simplified Chinese locale bundles contain wrong-language text (Italian and Traditional Chinese), causing incorrect OTP display to users.

title: Java MessageFormat syntax substituted into i18next bundles
description: MessageFormat placeholders {0} and choice syntax used instead of i18next {{0}} syntax, causing literal placeholder rendering in error messages.

title: Legal HTML flagged as illegal due to serialization differences
description:
Checker compares unsanitized source to sanitized output, causing false positives for legal HTML that serializes differently (e.g.,
vs
).

title: Anchor-mismatch errors lack context; key parameter unused
description: Error messages for anchor-mismatch failures omit file and key context, making errors unattributable; key parameter is accepted but never used.

title: Policy factories and HTML_TAGS are mutable non-static fields
description: POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML, and HTML_TAGS are non-static fields rebuilt for each file instead of being static final constants.

title: No test validates that valid bundles produce zero findings
description: Tests only assert that errors are found; no test validates that valid bundles produce empty results, missing false-positive regressions.
